title: Breaking Changes & Major Interaction API Expansion!
summary: This update introduces significant breaking changes by making several core parameters strictly required and numerous `GenaiVertexV1Interaction` properties read-only. On the feature front, a massive expansion of the `interactions` API enables advanced streaming, tool use (like code execution, file search, Google Maps/Search), and rich content handling for generative AI applications.
details:
Heads up, developers! This is a breaking change release. The parameters 'name', 'locationsId', 'projectsId', and 'parent' are now strictly required for various methods, which may impact existing API calls. Additionally, several properties within the `GenaiVertexV1Interaction` schema, including `created`, `environmentId`, `errors`, `id`, `status`, `steps`, `updated`, and `usage`, are now read-only. The `effectiveIdentity` property in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1Agent` and `continuationToken` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1Candidate` have also become read-only.

Beyond the breaking changes, this update brings a substantial new surface area for managing and interacting with generative AI models. New methods like `interactions.cancel`, `interactions.getPoll`, `interactions.getStream`, and `projects.locations.interactions.create` are now available. These methods, along with a plethora of new `GenaiVertexV1` schemas, introduce powerful capabilities for streaming interaction events, integrating various tools (e.g., `CodeExecution`, `FileSearch`, `GoogleMaps`, `GoogleSearch`, `Retrieval`, `UrlContext`), and handling diverse content types (audio, document, image, text, video) within your AI workflows. This significantly enhances the ability to build complex, multi-modal, and tool-augmented generative AI applications.
